company_name: Shandong Shengquan Electronic Materials Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company produces electronic chemicals and materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shandong Shengquan Electronic Materials Co., Ltd specializes in producing electronic chemicals, particularly phenolic resins and composite materials, which are essential for semiconductor packaging and insulation. The company also engages in biomass refining and new energy solutions, emphasizing sustainable practices in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Production of phenolic resins for semiconductor applications
Composite materials for packaging and insulation
Biomass refining for sustainable semiconductor processes
